audio.strategy: Stereo grand multisamples at minor thirds, two recorded dynamics. Velocity sets gain and layer. During loading or decode failure a decaying harmonic oscillator voice is available.

generatedSources: Live oscillator fallback; periodic wave with decaying gain.
notes: 25 roots from MIDI 27 through 99 in minor thirds. The nearest root is transposed at playback. Velocities 1–69 use v4, 70–127 use v10, with continuous per-strike gain scaling.
32 logical voices. At capacity, steal the oldest released voice, then the oldest sustained voice, then the oldest held voice. Stolen voices fade over 15 ms. Ordinary damper release takes 190 ms.

surface.panelBehavior: All physical panel controls update presentation state only. The keybed, mapped computer keys, Web MIDI and the external sustain switch operate the basic piano.
unsupported: Panel control of master level, wheel and pitch stick
